families.title: Data residency & movement
families.question: What stays close to compute?
families.description: Place, page, prefetch or offload weights, experts and KV state.
families.description_cn: 权重、专家和 KV 的驻留、分页、预取与卸载。

families.title: Numerical representation
families.title_cn: 数值表示与低比特执行
families.question: How is each value represented?
families.description: Co-design low-bit formats, layouts and execution kernels.
families.description_cn: 联合设计低比特格式、布局和执行内核。

families.title: Selective computation
families.question: Which work can be omitted?
families.description: Select neurons, tokens or attention blocks; expose approximation.
families.description_cn: 选择神经元、token 或注意力块，并明确近似条件。

families.title: Computation reuse
families.question: Which earlier results can be reused?
families.description: Reuse request prefixes, features or attention across steps.
families.description_cn: 复用请求前缀、特征或跨时间步注意力结果。

families.title: Generation order
families.question: Can more output be produced per step?
families.description: Draft and verify tokens, or reorganize block generation.
families.description_cn: 候选生成与验证，或重新组织块生成流程。

families.title: Parallelism & scheduling
families.question: Who executes what, and when?
families.description: Partition stages, devices and requests around workload constraints.
families.description_cn: 围绕负载约束安排阶段、设备与请求。

families.title: Compiled & native execution
families.question: How does a graph become an executable?
families.description: Fuse, lower, specialize and dispatch graphs or native kernels.
families.description_cn: 融合、降低抽象层级、专用化及分派原生内核。

families.title: Construction & validation tools
families.question: How are specialized programs built and checked?
families.question_cn: 专用程序怎样构建与检验？
families.description: Agents, kernel languages and evaluation infrastructure.
families.description_cn: 智能体、内核语言和评测基础设施。

roles.title: Specialized inference systems
roles.description: Integrated runtimes and substantial execution backends organized around concrete model, device or workload constraints.
roles.description_cn: 围绕具体模型、设备或负载约束组织执行的运行时和专用后端。

roles.title: Construction workflows
roles.description: Concrete model- or deployment-oriented workflows that generate, compile or adapt executable programs.
roles.description_cn: 面向具体模型或部署，生成、编译或改造可执行程序的构建流程。

roles.title: Supporting infrastructure and references
roles.description: General engines, reusable compilers, languages, kernels, mechanism components and evaluation tools.
roles.description_cn: 通用引擎、可复用编译器与语言、内核、机制组件和评测工具。

build_routes.title: Native implementation
build_routes.description: Implement the selected model graph and runtime policy; reuse lower-level libraries where useful.
build_routes.description_cn: 实现选定模型的计算图和运行策略，按需复用底层库。

build_routes.title: Specialized backend
build_routes.description: Keep shared framework services and replace a substantial execution subsystem.
build_routes.description_cn: 保留共享框架服务，替换关键执行子系统。

build_routes.title: Compiler-generated execution
build_routes.description: Lower a model or task graph into target-specific programs and runtime schedules.
build_routes.description_cn: 把模型或任务图编译为面向目标设备的程序与执行安排。

build_routes.title: Agent-guided construction
build_routes.description: Generate or revise kernels and servers, then inspect the resulting validation and integration.
build_routes.description_cn: 生成或修改内核及服务程序，检查产物的验证与集成。

survey_roles.title: Core cases
survey_roles.description: Purposeful reconstruction of execution paths, or a construction workflow linked to a concrete specialized artifact. These cases motivate investigation; they do not establish a new paradigm.
survey_roles.description_cn: 有明确目的的执行路径重建，或与具体专用产物相连的构建流程。用于提出和研究问题，不自动构成范式变化的证据。

survey_roles.title: Historical and adjacent routes
survey_roles.description: Earlier and contemporary routes that explain what already exists, or illuminate a narrower or different construction boundary. This is not an age cutoff.
survey_roles.description_cn: 说明哪些思想早已有之，或构建边界较窄、不同的已有及当代路线；不按年代硬切。

survey_roles.title: Shared foundations and baselines
survey_roles.description: General engines, compilers, kernels, components and evaluators used for reuse and controlled comparison.
survey_roles.description_cn: 提供复用关系与公平比较条件的通用引擎、编译器、内核、组件和评测工具。

case_groups.title: From a construction workflow to an engine
case_groups.title_cn: 构建流程实际产出了什么

case_groups.title: Rebuilding execution around deployment constraints
case_groups.title_cn: 围绕部署条件重建执行栈

case_groups.title: Specialized backends and generated programs
case_groups.title_cn: 专用后端与编译生成的执行程序
